subject: Follow-up: PHI scope & BAA for CardioHealth integration
messages:
From: Dr. Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cardiohealth.org>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial security questions re: PHI handling

Diego / Monica —

Thanks again for the demo today. A few quick follow-up items from our side as we evaluate Redwood for a PHI-bearing workflow:

- Can Redwood sign a BAA, and if so is there a standard draft we can review?
- Which deployment modes are eligible for processing PHI? Can hosted (shared) API be used if we redact PHI client-side, or is that off the table?
- What controls do you provide around data residency, KMS integration, and audit logs?

We also have an initial security questionnaire attached (CH_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx). I've looped in procurement to coordinate next steps and our security team will expect SOC 2 evidence if we move forward.

Would appreciate a short summary you can send back with concrete next steps and any documents we should review.

—Sarah
Dr. Sarah Lewis
Chief Medical Information Officer
CardioHealth Clinic

Attachment: CH_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (see attached spreadsheet)

From: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cardiohealth.org>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial security questions re: PHI handling

Thanks Sarah — great to meet today. Quick recap and concrete next steps below so procurement and your security team have everything in one place.

Recap / answers
- BAA: Yes, Redwood can execute a BAA. I'm attaching a draft (Redwood_BAA_draft.pdf). We typically sign a one-way BAA that covers processing on our side; we can iterate if your legal has edits.
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in your VPC) and Private (on-prem or VPC with customer-managed networking) are both supported and HIPAA-acceptable. Our multi-tenant hosted API (Redwood hosted public API) is not approved for PHI-bearing data.
- PHI boundaries: We recommend isolating all PHI traffic to a Dedicated or Private deployment. If you mask/redact prior to sending, you can use hosted for non-PHI telemetry, but we can't guarantee compliance for any PHI routed through the shared hosted endpoint.
- Key management & encryption: We support customer KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) for Dedicated and Private deployments; all data at rest is encrypted and in-flight is TLS. We can provide key rotation and audit logs as part of the Dedicated offering.
- SOC 2: Attached is our latest SOC 2 summary (soc2_summary_2025.pdf). For customers who require the full report we have an NDA process and a gate with our security team.

Next steps (proposed)
1) I attach the BAA draft for review (Redwood_BAA_draft.pdf). If your legal is comfortable we can route via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/AAABBB-CARDIO-CH-BAA
2) Marcus (cc'd) can schedule a tech call to walk through Dedicated deployment networking and KMS steps.
3) If you want SOC 2 full report, please confirm an NDA and I will coordinate with security to share.

Attachments: Redwood_BAA_draft.pdf, soc2_summary_2025.pdf

If helpful I'll put together a short one-pager that maps the PHI flow and where you should deploy agents/ingest to keep PHI in the Dedicated environment.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Healthcare
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cardiohealth.org>, diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial security questions re: PHI handling

Sarah — quick clarifying item from engineering while we prep the tech call:

- For Dedicated / Private: we support KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and can enable CMEK for data at rest. Is CardioHealth planning to bring keys or would you prefer Redwood-managed keys?
- Audit logs: we provide request-level audit logs for Dedicated deployments with retention options; if you have a retention policy (e.g., 7 years) please flag that now so we can confirm feasibility.

Marcus will reach out to schedule a 30-min network + KMS discussion. Thanks — Monica

—Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: procurement <procurement@cardiohealth.org>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cardiohealth.org>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial security questions re: PHI handling

Diego / Monica —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement and our security lead reviewed the attachments and the next steps look good. We have a couple minor redlines to the BAA (data retention paragraph and subprocessors list) — I'll send those in-track by EOD.

We prefer to bring our own KMS keys (AWS KMS) and want audit logs retained for 5 years. Please confirm those are supported for Dedicated.

Also please download our completed vendor questionnaire (attached). Once we have the NDA + SOC 2 report we can move to purchasing.

Best,
Procurement Team
CardioHealth Clinic

Attachment: CH_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx
